grammar.q: I was wondering ___ you could help me with the budget report.

grammar.q: Which request sounds the most polite in an email to a senior manager?

grammar.q: A colleague asks, "Would you mind if I joined the meeting?" You are happy for them to join. What do you say?

grammar.q: "How long ___ this cough?" the doctor asked.

grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Choose the best answer: "You look exhausted." — "I know. I ___ late every night this week."
grammar.explain_zh: this week 還沒結束，而且「看起來很累」是這陣子持續加班的結果，用現在完成進行式最自然。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence focuses on HOW MANY, not on the ongoing activity?
options: I've been taking painkillers all week.
grammar.explain_zh: 有具體次數／數量（four painkillers）時用現在完成式 have taken，強調結果；其他三句都在描述持續的狀態或動作。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: I ___ the doctor last Tuesday, and she ___ me some eye drops.
grammar.explain_zh: last Tuesday 是明確的過去時間點，兩個動作都已結束，都用過去式。看到明確過去時間（yesterday、last…、ago、in 2024）就用過去式。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: I ___ (never / need) a referral before, so I'm not sure how it works.
grammar.explain_zh: 到目前為止的人生經驗、沒有特定時間點，用現在完成式；never 放在 have 和 p.p. 之間。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've had the flu two weeks ago.
I had the flu two weeks ago, but I've felt fine since then.
I had the flu two weeks ago, but I felt fine since then.
I've had the flu two weeks ago, but I felt fine since then.
grammar.explain_zh: two weeks ago 用過去式 had；since then 是「從那時到現在」，用現在完成式 have felt。一句裡兩種時態各管各的時間。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: ___ we split the work into two phases? (提議：我們何不…？)
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we + 原形動詞？是友善的提議，don't 放在 we 前面（不是 Why we don't）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that she ___ the client before Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: I'd suggest that + 主詞 + 原形動詞：that 子句的動詞用原形，主詞是 she 也不加 s，所以是 call（美式與正式英文的標準用法；英式也常說 should call）。不要因為有 I'd 就改成過去式 called；suggest 不接 to call，that 子句裡也不能只放 calling。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I suggest you to update the timeline.
I'd suggest to update the timeline.
I suggest you updating the timeline.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面接名詞、V-ing 或 that 子句（that 可省略：I'd suggest you update…），不接 to V，也不接「人 + to V」或「人 + V-ing」。正確是 I'd suggest updating…
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: How about ___ (move) the review to Thursday?
grammar.explain_zh: How about / What about 後面接 V-ing。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: You're in a meeting with a senior manager from another department. Which suggestion sounds the most polite?
options: We have to change the plan.
I'd suggest that we take another look at the plan.
Why you don't change the plan?
grammar.explain_zh: I'd suggest that we… 語氣委婉又正式。「We have to change the plan.」和「Change the plan.」聽起來像命令；「Why you don't change the plan?」語序錯誤，應該是 Why don't you…?
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that he ___ (touch) base with the design team before the next milestone.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that 子句用原形動詞，主詞是 he 也不加 s：touch base（美式與正式英文；英式常說 should touch，也算對）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: We ___ (work) on this proposal since September, and it still isn't finished.
grammar.explain_zh: since September 到現在還在做（still isn't finished），用 have been + V-ing。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: I ___ the report yesterday afternoon, so you should have it already.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確的過去時間點 yesterday afternoon → 用過去式 finished。時間點用過去式、持續到現在才用完成（進行）式。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: "Sorry I'm late! ___ long?" — "No, just a few minutes."
grammar.explain_zh: 對方從過去等到現在（剛剛還在等），問「你等很久了嗎」用現在完成進行式 Have you been waiting long?
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: "The phone's ringing." — "Don't worry, ___ it."
grammar.explain_zh: 電話剛響，說話當下才決定去接（主動幫忙）→ will：I'll get it。I'm going to get it 文法沒錯，但 going to 表示事先就決定好的打算，用在這裡不自然；I'd get it 是假設語氣，要有條件才用；I get it 是「我懂了」，意思不對。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: "Are you free at 10 tomorrow?" — "Sorry, ___ the vendor then. It's been on my calendar all week."
grammar.explain_zh: 早就排進行事曆、時間確定的安排 → 現在進行式 I'm meeting。I'll meet 文法沒錯，但聽起來像是現在才決定要去見廠商，和「整週都排在行事曆上」矛盾；現在簡單式 I meet 多用在時刻表（The train leaves at 9.），講自己跟人約好的事不自然；I'd meet 是假設語氣，要有條件才用。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Look at these numbers. We ___ (miss) our Q4 target unless something changes.
grammar.explain_zh: 看著眼前的數字（證據）做預測，最常用 be going to：We're going to miss… 主詞 we 要配 are，別漏掉 be 動詞。will miss 也可以接受。後面有 unless 條件，will miss 也很自然。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: I think the new plan ___ even by next summer.
grammar.explain_zh: I think + 一般預測 → will + 原形動詞（will break even）。is breaking 是已排定的安排，「打平」不是能排進行事曆的事；will 後面一定接原形，will breaks 多了 -s；is going break 少了 to（說 is going to break even 也對）。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Sorry, I can't make Thursday. I ___ (fly) to Tokyo that morning — my flight's already booked.
grammar.explain_zh: 機票已經訂好、行程確定 → 現在進行式 I'm flying 最自然；I'm going to fly 也可以，I'll be flying（那時候正在飛）也是道地說法。I'll fly 聽起來像現在才決定，這裡不自然。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I'm going to raise the headcount issue myself.
I going to raise the headcount issue myself.
I'm going raise the headcount issue myself.
I will to raise the headcount issue myself.
grammar.explain_zh: be going to + 原形動詞，三個部分都不能少：I'm（be 動詞）＋ going to ＋ raise。will 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Sign-ups ___ (grow) by 18% since we launched the new plan.
grammar.explain_zh: since + 過去時間點，表示「從那時到現在」→ 現在完成式 have grown。主詞 sign-ups 是複數，用 have。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: We ___ the new pricing in September.
grammar.explain_zh: in September 是明確、已經結束的過去時間 → 過去式 launched。現在完成式不能和 in September、yesterday、last week 這類明確的過去時間連用（但可以說 since September）；have been launching 同理不行；had launch 形式錯誤。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: I ___ on this team for three years now, so I know the numbers well.
grammar.explain_zh: for three years now 表示從三年前一直延續到現在（現在還在這個團隊）→ 現在完成式 have worked。worked 是過去式，表示那段經歷已經結束，不能和 now 連用；am working／work 都不能搭配 for three years 表示「到現在已經多久」。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: My flight ___ (leave) Taipei three hours late last night.
grammar.explain_zh: last night 是明確的過去時間，事情已經結束 → 過去式 left。不能說 has left last night。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: So far, the airline ___ (cancel) four flights because of the storm.
grammar.explain_zh: so far（到目前為止）表示從過去累積到現在 → 現在完成式。主詞 the airline 是單數，用 has。美式拼 canceled、英式拼 cancelled，都可以。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: I ___ (be) at this airport since midnight, and I'm exhausted.
grammar.explain_zh: since midnight 表示從半夜一直到現在 → have been。中文「我從半夜就在這裡」沒有時態變化，但英文不能說 I am here since midnight。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: Ticket prices ___ (go) up a lot since last summer.
grammar.explain_zh: since last summer → 現在完成式，主詞 prices 是複數，用 have gone；強調一路持續上漲也可以說 have been going up。注意不要寫成 have been gone：go 是不及物動詞，沒有被動，have been gone 只用在「離開多久了」（He's been gone for an hour）。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: When ___ your new boarding pass?
grammar.explain_zh: When 問的是「哪個時間點」，答案一定是過去的某個時刻 → 過去式 did you get。現在完成式不能和 When 問句連用；you got 少了助動詞 did，是問句語序錯誤。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've missed my connecting flight yesterday.
I've been missed my connecting flight yesterday.
I was miss my connecting flight yesterday.
I missed my connecting flight yesterday.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是明確的過去時間 → 過去式 I missed。have missed 不能接 yesterday；have been missed 是被動，意思和形式都不對；was miss 混用了 be 動詞和原形。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: My throat ___ (hurt) since we boarded the plane.
grammar.explain_zh: 從登機開始痛、到現在還在痛 → has been hurting（been 後面接 V-ing）。不要寫成 has been hurt：have/has been + 過去分詞是被動（被傷害），意思完全不同。主詞 my throat 是單數，用 has。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去開始、到現在還在持續的狀況（have/has been + V-ing）

grammar.q: I ___ (try) to call the airline for an hour, but nobody is picking up.
grammar.explain_zh: 從一小時前開始打、到現在還在打 → 現在完成進行式 have been trying（been 後面接 V-ing）。for an hour 表示持續多久，而且動作還沒結束，所以不用過去式 tried。注意不要寫成 have been tried：have been + 過去分詞是被動（被嘗試），意思不對。主詞是 I，用 have。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去開始、到現在還在持續的狀況（have/has been + V-ing）

grammar.q: We ___ in this line for forty minutes, and it still isn't moving.
grammar.explain_zh: for forty minutes 到現在還在排 → have been standing（been + V-ing）。have been stood 是「被動＋過去分詞」的錯誤組合；stood 表示已經結束；are standing 不能搭配 for forty minutes 表示持續多久。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去開始、到現在還在持續的狀況（have/has been + V-ing）

grammar.q: When I got to the meeting, the client ___ (already / leave).
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（我到會議的時候），客戶離開發生在更早之前 → had + p.p.。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: Ethan ___ (work) on the export feature since 9 a.m., and he's still at it.
grammar.explain_zh: since 9 a.m. 加上 still at it（現在還在做）→ 現在完成進行式 has been + V-ing。主詞 Ethan 是單數，用 has。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: By the time Priya found out on Thursday, Ethan ___ (already / promise) the client a new date.
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（Priya 週四發現的時候），答應新日期發生在更早之前，而且已經完成 → had + p.p.。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: By the end of last week, Legal ___ (review) only two of the five contracts.
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（上週結束時），在那之前完成的數量 → had + p.p.。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: Ethan was exhausted on Thursday because he ___ (work) on the feature all night.
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（週四很累），在那之前「整晚一直在做」→ had been + V-ing，強調持續的過程。had worked 文法上也對，但 all night 強調持續過程，用 had been working 最自然。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: "Where's Priya?" "She ___ to the client's office, so she won't be back until three."
grammar.explain_zh: 人已經去了、現在不在 → has gone。has been going 是「最近常常去」，不能說明她現在不在；goes 是習慣，也不對。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: I'd suggest that we ___ (move) the demo to Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that 後面的子句用原形動詞（move），不要寫 moves 或 to move。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Which question is a natural suggestion?
options: Why don't we ask the client for one more week?
Why we don't ask the client for one more week?
Why not we ask the client for one more week?
Why don't ask we the client for one more week?
grammar.explain_zh: 提出建議的固定語序是 Why don't we + 原形動詞。Why not 後面直接接原形動詞（Why not ask…?），不加 we。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest ___ (check) with the team before we give the client a date.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作時用 V-ing（I'd suggest checking…），不能用 to check。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Under our policy, every new hire ___ (have to) finish security training in the first week.
grammar.explain_zh: 題目指定用 have to：規定要求、一定得做 → have to。主詞 every new hire 是單數，要用 has to。（也可以說 is supposed to，但語氣較弱，常暗示「規定是這樣，實際不一定做到」。）
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: You look exhausted. You'd better ___ (go) home and rest.
grammar.explain_zh: had better（'d better）後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to：You'd better go。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: The update ___ (be supposed to) go out yesterday, but it was delayed.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是過去，而且「本來應該、結果沒做到」→ was supposed to。主詞 the update 是單數，用 was。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: It's only a small bug, so the customer ___ (not / have to) reinstall the app.
grammar.explain_zh: 「不必」→ don't have to。主詞 the customer 是單數，要用 doesn't have to（不是 don't）。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Under the contract, we ___ reply within 24 hours, but we took three days.
grammar.explain_zh: 合約規定要 24 小時內回覆，但實際花了三天 → 「本來應該、結果沒做到」用 were supposed to。後半句 but we took three days 是關鍵線索。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Which sentence is a warning?
options: You'd better test it before the demo, or it might crash.
You don't have to test it before the demo.
You were supposed to test it yesterday.
grammar.explain_zh: had better 表示「最好…，不然會出事」，後面的 or it might crash 就是警告的後果。其他三句分別是「不必」、「本來應該」、「已經做過」。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Since the new version launched, sign-ups ___ (grow) by 18%.
grammar.explain_zh: since 到現在、而且有具體數字（18%）→ 用 have + p.p.（have grown），不用進行式 have been growing。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: The client ___ (cancel) three orders so far this month.
grammar.explain_zh: so far this month（到目前為止）＋次數（three orders）→ 現在完成式。主詞 the client 是單數，要用 has。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: "When ___ the outage?" "Around 2 a.m."
grammar.explain_zh: When 問的是過去某個明確時間點 → 用過去式 did you notice，不用現在完成式；have you been noticed 是被動，意思也不對。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: If the apartment ___ (have) a washing machine, we would sign the lease today.
grammar.explain_zh: 和現在事實相反（其實沒有洗衣機），if 子句用過去式 had。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: If I ___ (be) you, I would ask for a one-year lease first.
grammar.explain_zh: If I were you 是給建議的固定說法；口語也可以說 was。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: If the landlord lowered the rent, we ___ (stay) another year.
grammar.explain_zh: if 子句已經用過去式 lowered，主要子句用 would + 原形。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: If the building ___ (allow) pets, my sister would move in tomorrow.
grammar.explain_zh: 主詞 the building 是第三人稱單數，但第二條件句的 if 子句用過去式，所以是 allowed，不是 allows。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: We can't afford this place on our own, but if we ___ a roommate, we could.
grammar.explain_zh: 主要子句是 could（第二條件句），if 子句用過去式 found；if 子句不放 will 或 would。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: The landlord says he will fix the heater this week. If he ___ it, we'll stay.
grammar.explain_zh: 這是很有可能發生的事（他說這週會修），主要子句是 we'll stay，所以用第一條件句：if + 現在式 fixes。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: Why don't we ___ (ask) the landlord for a two-year lease?
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we 後面接原形動詞。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that you ___ every room before you move in.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（that 子句裡用原形）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest ___ (visit) the apartment at night to check the noise.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作時用 V-ing，不接 to V。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Why don't we ___ (ask) them for a service credit first?
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we 後面接原形動詞 ask。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest ___ (lock) in the current rate for two years.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面沒有人、直接接動作時用 V-ing：locking，不是 to lock。也可以說 suggest (that) we lock。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: How about ___ (offer) them a longer contract?
grammar.explain_zh: How about 後面接 V-ing：offering。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that our manager ___ (join) the next call.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that + 人 + 原形：主詞 our manager 是單數也不加 s，用 join（英式也常說 should join）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: The vendor wants 15% more. I'd suggest ___ two other quotes before we reply.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作用 V-ing：getting。suggest 不接 to V，也不能直接接原形或過去式。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: ___ we push the renewal call to Friday? Nobody has read the contract yet.
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we + 原形 是友善的提議（我們要不要…）；其他選項是在真的問原因，意思不通。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: ___ the heavy traffic, Mark arrived only five minutes late. (despite / although)
grammar.explain_zh: 後面是名詞 the heavy traffic（沒有動詞），所以用 Despite。although 後面要接完整句子。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: ___ my new apartment is smaller, I really like the neighborhood. (although / despite)
grammar.explain_zh: 後面是完整句子 my new apartment is smaller（主詞＋動詞），所以用 Although。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Although Ana ___ (work) here for only two weeks, she already knows everyone.
grammar.explain_zh: for only two weeks 從過去持續到現在，主詞 Ana 是單數：has been working 或 has worked 都對。不能用 have，也不能用過去式 worked。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Despite ___ (feel) sick, Priya finished the report on time.
grammar.explain_zh: despite 後面接名詞或 V-ing，所以用 feeling，不是 feel 或 she felt。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Kevin likes working from the office, ___ Priya prefers working from home.
grammar.explain_zh: 兩個人的習慣互相對比、後面是完整句子，用 whereas。despite／in spite of 不接句子；however 不能用逗號接在句子中間。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: I've asked the landlord for my deposit twice. ___, he still hasn't sent it.
grammar.explain_zh: 前一句已經用句號結束，新句子開頭表示轉折、後面有逗號，用 However。Despite、Although、Whereas 都要和另一個子句或名詞連在同一句。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Excuse me, could you tell me where the fitting rooms ___ (be)?
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句用直述句順序：the fitting rooms are。主詞是複數，所以用 are，放在句尾。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Could you tell me when you ___ (buy) it? Was it last Monday?
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確的過去時間點（last Monday），用過去式 bought。間接問句不加 did，所以不是 when did you buy。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Do you know how long you ___ (have) the purifier? Since August?
grammar.explain_zh: Since August 是從過去持續到現在，用現在完成式 have had。have 是狀態動詞，不說 have been having。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Do you know whether the store ___ (change) its return policy since last year?
grammar.explain_zh: since last year 到現在，用現在完成式；主詞 the store 是單數，所以用 has changed，不是 have changed。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Can you tell me ___?
options: what time does the store close
what time is the store closes
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句不加 does，用直述句順序「主詞＋動詞」：what time the store closes。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: I was wondering ___ I could get store credit instead.
grammar.explain_zh: 原本是 yes/no 問題（Can I get store credit?），要用 if 或 whether 接起來。that 用在陳述事實，不能用來問問題。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

translate.zh: 不知道你能不能在開會前幫我看一下簡報。
translate.en: I was wondering if you could review my slides before the meeting.

translate.zh: 我們的通話可以改到下午三點嗎？
translate.en: Would it be possible to move our call to 3 p.m.?

translate.zh: 可以麻煩你把最新版本寄給我嗎？
translate.en: Would you mind sending me the latest version?

translate.zh: 我想先提出一個問題：這個時程可能不太可行。
translate.en: I'd like to flag an issue first: this timeline might not be feasible.
alt: I want to flag an issue first: this schedule may not be feasible.

translate.zh: 如果我們縮小範圍，週五還是可以上線。
translate.en: If we reduce the scope, we can still launch on Friday.
alt: If we cut the scope, we can still go live on Friday.

translate.zh: 不知道我們能不能把會議延到下週一？
translate.en: I was wondering if we could push back the meeting to next Monday.
alt: I was wondering if we could push the meeting back to next Monday.

translate.zh: 到目前為止我們完成了五個里程碑中的三個。
translate.en: We've completed three of the five milestones so far.

translate.zh: 我們上週四完成了第二個里程碑。
translate.en: We completed the second milestone last Thursday.

translate.zh: 客戶核准設計了沒？
translate.en: Has the client signed off on the design yet?

translate.zh: 整體來說，這個專案仍按計畫進行。
translate.en: Overall, the project is still on track.
alt: Overall, the project is still on schedule.

translate.zh: 我們已經完成了付款流程。
translate.en: We've finished the payment flow.
alt: We have completed the payment flow.
We've completed the payment flow.

translate.zh: 我們上週二推出了新版本。
translate.en: We rolled out the new version last Tuesday.
alt: We released the new version last Tuesday.

translate.zh: 法務還沒核准合約，這是我們目前最大的卡關點。
translate.en: Legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet, and that's our biggest blocker right now.
alt: Legal hasn't approved the contract yet, which is our biggest blocker at the moment.

translate.zh: 退款頁面會順延到下週，我明天會再跟供應商追蹤。
translate.en: The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor again tomorrow.
alt: The refund pages will be carried over to next week. I'll follow up with the supplier tomorrow.
The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor tomorrow.

translate.zh: 從專案開始以來，我一直睡不好。
translate.en: I've been sleeping badly since the project started.

translate.zh: 她吃這個藥兩週了，沒有任何副作用。
translate.en: She's been taking this medicine for two weeks, and she hasn't had any side effects.

translate.zh: 你眼睛好紅，是不是盯著螢幕一整天？
translate.en: Your eyes look red. Have you been staring at a screen all day?

translate.zh: 我這兩個禮拜一直睡不好。
translate.en: I've been sleeping badly for the past two weeks.
alt: I haven't been sleeping well for the past two weeks.
I've been having trouble sleeping for two weeks.

translate.zh: 這個藥有副作用嗎？
translate.en: Does this medicine have any side effects?
alt: Are there any side effects with this medicine?

translate.zh: 如果還是沒好，我會幫你轉診。
translate.en: If it still doesn't get better, I'll give you a referral.
alt: If it doesn't improve, I'll write you a referral.
If it still isn't better, I'll refer you to a specialist.

translate.zh: 我們何不在確定時程前，先跟客戶開個簡短的電話會議？
translate.en: Why don't we set up a quick call with the client before we finalize the timeline?

translate.zh: 我建議每個團隊指定一位窗口。
translate.en: I'd suggest that each team name one point of contact.

translate.zh: 我建議先從小規模試行開始，之後再擴大。
translate.en: I'd suggest starting with a smaller pilot and expanding it later.

translate.zh: 我們何不先開個短會，把主要的交付項目講清楚？
translate.en: Why don't we have a quick meeting first to clarify the main deliverables?
alt: Why don't we start with a short meeting to make the main deliverables clear?
Why don't we have a short meeting first to go over the main deliverables?

translate.zh: 我建議每個部門指定一位窗口。
translate.en: I'd suggest that each department name a point of contact.
alt: I'd suggest that each department choose a point of contact.
I suggest that each department appoint a point of contact.

translate.zh: 這兩個禮拜我們一直在準備專案啟動會議。
translate.en: We've been preparing for the project kickoff meeting for the past two weeks.
alt: For the last two weeks, we've been getting ready for the project kickoff.
We've been preparing for the kickoff meeting for two weeks.

translate.zh: 我們 3 月 3 日推出春季活動。（已經排定）
translate.en: We're launching the spring campaign on March 3rd.

translate.zh: 我打算用一個重點結論開場。（已經決定）
translate.en: I'm going to open the presentation with one key takeaway.

translate.zh: 我想新方案大概會在七月前打平。（預測）
translate.en: I think the new plan will probably break even by July.

translate.zh: 我們下週二要跟客戶開會，已經排好了。
translate.en: We're meeting the client next Tuesday. It's already scheduled.
alt: We're meeting with the client next Tuesday; it's already been scheduled.
We have a meeting with the client next Tuesday. It's already set up.

translate.zh: 我覺得新方案大概會在明年夏天打平。
translate.en: I think the new plan will probably break even next summer.
alt: I think the new plan is probably going to break even next summer.
I think the new plan will probably break even by next summer.

translate.zh: 我們九月推出了新價格，從那之後註冊人數已經成長了 18%。
translate.en: We launched the new pricing in September, and sign-ups have grown by 18% since then.
alt: We launched the new prices in September, and since then sign-ups have gone up 18%.
We introduced the new pricing in September, and sign-ups have increased by 18% since then.

translate.zh: 我們昨晚 11:40 降落曼谷。（明確的時間點→過去式）
translate.en: We landed in Bangkok at 11:40 last night.

translate.zh: 我已經幫你改訂早上的班機了。（沒說何時，重點是現在已經訂好）
translate.en: I've already rebooked you on the morning flight.

translate.zh: 她從 2019 年起就在這家航空公司工作。（一直延續到現在）
translate.en: She has worked for the airline since 2019.

translate.zh: 自從我們推出新方案以來，註冊人數已經成長了 18%。
translate.en: Sign-ups have grown by 18% since we launched the new plan.
alt: Sign-ups have increased by 18% since we launched the new plan.
Sign-ups have gone up by 18% since we launched the new plan.

translate.zh: 我的班機昨晚延誤了三個小時。
translate.en: My flight was delayed by three hours last night.
alt: My flight was three hours late last night.
Last night, my flight was delayed by three hours.
My flight was delayed for three hours last night.

translate.zh: 到目前為止，我已經改訂了兩次機票。
translate.en: So far, I've rebooked my flight twice.
alt: So far, I have rebooked my flight twice.
I've rebooked my flight twice so far.
I have rebooked my flight twice so far.

translate.zh: 測試版推出以來，我們已經修好十二個 bug。
translate.en: We've fixed twelve bugs since the beta.

translate.zh: 我從九點就在寫這份報告，到現在還沒寫完。
translate.en: I've been working on this report since nine, and I'm still not done.

translate.zh: 我三月加入的時候，團隊已經推出測試版了。
translate.en: When I joined in March, the team had already launched the beta.

translate.zh: Marcus 累壞了，因為他整個週末都在修 bug。
translate.en: Marcus was exhausted because he'd been fixing bugs all weekend.

translate.zh: 自從我們推出新的定價頁以來，註冊人數已經成長了 18%。
translate.en: Sign-ups have grown by 18% since we launched the new pricing page.
alt: Since we launched the new pricing page, sign-ups have grown by 18%.

translate.zh: 自從上週推出測試版以來，團隊已經修好了十二個 bug。
translate.en: The team has fixed twelve bugs since we launched the beta last week.
alt: We've fixed twelve bugs since we launched the beta last week.

translate.zh: 我加入公司的時候，他們已經在這個專案上做了一年了。
translate.en: When I joined the company, they had been working on this project for a year.
alt: When I joined the company, they had already been working on this project for a year.

translate.zh: 我們推出新的定價頁之前，註冊人數已經連續三個月下滑了。
translate.en: Sign-ups had been falling for three months before we launched the new pricing page.
alt: Before we launched the new pricing page, sign-ups had been falling for three months.
Sign-ups had been dropping for three months before we launched the new pricing page.

translate.zh: 每一筆退款都要經過主管核准。
translate.en: A manager has to approve every refund.

translate.zh: 你不必留下來加班，修正可以等到明天。
translate.en: You don't have to stay late. The fix can wait until tomorrow.

translate.zh: 我們本來應該星期一跟客戶更新進度，結果沒人做。
translate.en: We were supposed to update the client on Monday, but nobody did.

translate.zh: 你最好在 Dana 把事情鬧到你老闆那裡之前先打給她。
translate.en: You'd better call Dana before she escalates it to your boss.

translate.zh: 自從我們推出新版本以來，客訴已經減少了 30%。
translate.en: Since we launched the new version, complaints have dropped by 30%.
alt: Complaints have dropped by 30% since we launched the new version.
Since we launched the new version, complaints have gone down by 30%.
Since we released the new version, complaints have decreased by 30%.

translate.zh: 我到公司的時候，客戶已經寄了三封 email。
translate.en: By the time I got to the office, the client had already sent three emails.
alt: When I got to the office, the client had already sent three emails.
By the time I arrived at the office, the client had already sent three emails.

translate.zh: 她打電話來之前，她的團隊已經手動追蹤貨物一整個早上了。
translate.en: Before she called, her team had been tracking shipments by hand all morning.
alt: Her team had been tracking shipments by hand all morning before she called.
Before she called, her team had been tracking the shipments manually all morning.

translate.zh: 你最好先打電話給客戶，再寫 email。
translate.en: You'd better call the client before you write the email.
alt: You had better call the client before you write the email.
You'd better call the client first, before writing the email.
You'd better call the client first and then write the email.

translate.zh: 照規定，我們應該在兩小時內把問題往上呈報。
translate.en: Under our policy, we're supposed to escalate the problem within two hours.
alt: According to our policy, we're supposed to escalate the issue within two hours.
Under our policy, we are supposed to escalate the problem within two hours.

translate.zh: 如果那間有陽台，我們馬上就租。（但其實沒有）
translate.en: If the apartment had a balcony, we would take it right away.

translate.zh: 如果我是你，我會問清楚有沒有包水電。
translate.en: If I were you, I would ask whether utilities are included.

translate.zh: 如果我們找到室友，就租得起大一點的地方。
translate.en: If we found a roommate, we could afford a bigger place.

translate.zh: 如果這間公寓有陽台，我們今天就會簽約。
translate.en: If this apartment had a balcony, we would sign the lease today.
alt: If this apartment had a balcony, we'd sign the lease today.
If the apartment had a balcony, we would sign the lease today.

translate.zh: 如果我是你，我會先要求看一下水電費帳單。
translate.en: If I were you, I would ask to see the utility bills first.
alt: If I were you, I'd ask to see the utility bills first.

translate.zh: 這一區的房租自去年以來已經上漲了 12%。
translate.en: Rent in this area has gone up by 12% since last year.
alt: Rents in this area have gone up by 12% since last year.
Rent in this area has increased by 12% since last year.
Rent in this area has risen by 12% since last year.

translate.zh: 我們看到那間公寓的時候，已經找房子找了兩個月。
translate.en: When we saw that apartment, we had been looking for a place for two months.
alt: We had been looking for a place for two months when we saw that apartment.
When we saw that apartment, we had been apartment hunting for two months.

translate.zh: 我們搬進去之前，房東已經把廚房重新粉刷好了。
translate.en: Before we moved in, the landlord had already repainted the kitchen.
alt: The landlord had already repainted the kitchen before we moved in.
The landlord had repainted the kitchen before we moved in.

translate.zh: 我們要不要先從九月那次服務中斷談起？
translate.en: Why don't we start with the outage in September?

translate.zh: 我建議向另外兩家廠商要報價。
translate.en: I'd suggest asking two other vendors for quotes.

translate.zh: 我建議星期五的電話由 Mia 主談。
translate.en: I'd suggest that Mia lead the call on Friday.

translate.zh: 我們何不先跟他們談九月那次服務中斷的事？
translate.en: Why don't we talk to them about the September outage first?
alt: Why don't we talk to them about the outage in September first?
Why don't we first talk to them about the September outage?
Why don't we discuss the September outage with them first?

translate.zh: 我建議我們回覆之前，先拿到另外兩家的報價。
translate.en: I'd suggest that we get two other quotes before we reply.
alt: I'd suggest we get two other quotes before we reply.
I'd suggest getting two other quotes before we reply.
I'd suggest getting quotes from two other companies before we reply.
I'd suggest that we get quotes from two other vendors before we reply.

translate.zh: 他們的價格自去年以來已經上漲了 15%。
translate.en: Their prices have gone up by 15% since last year.
alt: Their prices have increased by 15% since last year.
